speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing episodic cough and shortness of breath; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and what specific activities or times of day seem to trigger them?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious cough and reactive airway disease. The patient's 1-month history of episodic, nonproductive cough worsening with exertion and at night, following a respiratory infection 8 weeks ago, is characteristic of post-infectious bronchial hyperresponsiveness. I do not require further testing to confirm this clinical picture based on the provided history.
